article_title: France braces for national day of student protests after injuries and mass arrests

tasks.prompt: What is the central focus of the article?
options: The history of France's 1968 worker strikes
A planned national day of action after escalating student protests, injuries and arrests
A proposal to close all French universities permanently
A teachers' campaign to replace the education minister
tasks.correct_answer: A planned national day of action after escalating student protests, injuries and arrests
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת ביום מחאה ארצי מתוכנן בעקבות התרחבות מחאות התלמידים, הפציעות הקשות ואלפי המעצרים.

tasks.prompt: Which complaints helped start the student protests?
options: Higher university tuition for foreign students only
A ban on political organisations in schools
Shorter holidays and too many sports lessons
Overcrowded classrooms, run-down buildings and a lack of teachers
tasks.correct_answer: Overcrowded classrooms, run-down buildings and a lack of teachers
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מונה כיתות צפופות, מבנים מוזנחים ומחסור במורים בין הסיבות המרכזיות למחאה.

tasks.prompt: What does “blockading” mean in the sentence about students blockading hundreds of schools?
options: Blocking access to the schools
Repairing school entrances
Holding lessons outdoors
Moving students to other buildings
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר המחאה, blockading פירושו חסימת הכניסה או הגישה לבתי הספר.

tasks.prompt: What proportion of the 5,060 people arrested were minors, according to the justice ministry?
options: About half
All of them
tasks.explanation_hebrew: משרד המשפטים הצרפתי דיווח כי 87% מהעצורים היו קטינים ו־13% היו מבוגרים.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article describe the government's measures as failing to end the dispute?
options: The prime minister refused to discuss school conditions at all
The USL said the promises offered nothing concrete while students continued to face the same problems
All schools had already returned to normal
The teachers' union opposed every form of student action
tasks.correct_answer: The USL said the promises offered nothing concrete while students continued to face the same problems
tasks.explanation_hebrew: למרות הבטחת הממשלה לשינויים נראים לעין, ארגון USL טען שאין הצעה קונקרטית ולכן המבוי הסתום נמשך.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “proportionate” mean when the interior minister describes the policing?
options: Secret and unreported
Limited to adult protesters
Controlled by student unions
Appropriate in scale to the situation
tasks.correct_answer: Appropriate in scale to the situation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: השר טען שהשיטור היה מידתי — כלומר מתאים בהיקפו ובחומרתו למצב — בתגובה לטענה על שימוש בכוח מופרז.

tasks.prompt: Describe the two serious student injuries highlighted in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לתאר את שתי הפציעות: נער בן 15 שאיבד את ידו בעימות ליד Lens, ועדן בן 14 שסבל משבר כפול בלסת לאחר שנפגע לפי הדיווח מרימון גז מדמיע.
expected_points: A 15-year-old boy's hand was blown off during a confrontation near a school in Lens; officials said the injury was not life-threatening.
Eden, 14, reportedly suffered a double jaw fracture after being struck in the head by a tear gas grenade and underwent major surgery.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the sequence from the start of the demonstrations to the planned nationwide action on Tuesday.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לתאר את תחילת המחאה בפריז בספטמבר, התפשטותה ברחבי צרפת והצטרפות סטודנטים, ההסלמה בחסימות, עימותים, פציעות ומעצרים, והקריאה ליום פעולה ארצי.
expected_points: The demonstrations began in Paris in September over education conditions.
They spread nationwide, with university students joining high-school students.
Blockades, fires and clashes brought serious injuries and more than 5,000 arrests.
The USL and supporting groups called for nationwide action on Tuesday after rejecting the government's response as insufficient.

tasks.prompt: How has the protest movement become politically polarised, according to the article?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להשוות בין הטענות: הממשלה והימין הקיצוני מאשימים את השמאל בליבוי מהומות, בעוד Mélenchon מאשים את המשטרה בניצול לרעה של כוח ותומך בהרחבת המחאה.
expected_points: The government and hard-right figures accuse the hard left of fuelling or organising riots.
Marine Le Pen calls for a new anti-rioting law.
Mélenchon blames police abuses and urges people to protect youth demonstrations.
The Marseille mayor recognises legitimate concerns but calls for calm.

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced two-sentence news brief that presents both the students' demands and the authorities' response.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג באופן ניטרלי את דרישות התלמידים להשקעה ותנאי לימוד טובים יותר, לצד הבטחות הממשלה לשינויים והצהרתה שלא תוותר מול אלימות.
expected_points: State the students' concerns about overcrowding, buildings, staffing or investment.
Mention the government's promised measures or visible changes.
Include the authorities' position against violence or claim that policing was proportionate.
